candidate.title: Stored XSS: Post.cook returns raw HTML unchanged when cook_method=raw_html, bypassing sanitization/filtering
reports: post.rb:133 lets any user who can edit a rawhtml post submit arbitrary unsanitized html via the normal edit ui since postrevisor preserves cookmethod

stored xss: imported feed/fetched html is cooked and stored with zero sanitization (post.rb:131 cook returns raw unchanged for rawhtml and skips the afterpostcook plugin filter; no sanitizer or readability whitelist in topicembed.rb:22/35-37 or pollfeed.rb:35-36; skipvalidations: true bypasses the normal pipeline) and is rendered raw via '<%= raw post.cooked %>' in embed/best.html.erb:19 and on the forum topic page — since the embed iframe is served from the discourse origin with the viewer's cookies, any injected script executes with full session access, including admin sessions

[advisory] postrevisor accepts new raw but never touches cookmethod, so staff edits to imported rawhtml posts are saved without ever being cooked. a moderator who edits an imported article through the standard editor gets their markdown rendered verbatim as source text (postcook returns raw unchanged for rawhtml posts), visibly breaking the post after a routine moderation action with no ui path to fix it.
